title: Alsona
summary: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls
body: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

title: Maxma
summary: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance
body: Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

title: Latch.ai
summary: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt
body: Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.
